snippet.title: 나이 많은 남자친구를 만나면 안되는 이유
snippet.description:
죄송합니다, 오늘은 상세설명 칸에 상황 보고를 드리러 가영이 대신 저 편집몬이 왔습니다!

그래서 지금 눈이 어떻게 됐냐! 결론부터 말하면… 살아났습니다(?) 아니, 눈이 아주 좋아졌습니다!
그냥 좋아진 게 아니라 한 90%는 개선된 듯합니다. 인공눈물을 거의 하루에 반 통씩 쓰면서 버텼었는데, 원인이 속눈썹 때문이었다니… 이럴 거면 진작 병원 갈 걸 그랬네요. 내 눈물값…🥲

아! 참고로 탈모약 위O비도 정말 효과가 좋더군요. 고민하고 계시는 분들이 있다면 무조건 추천드리는 바입니다! (제 머리카락이 증인입니다)

그래서 뭐 이런 게 중요한 건 아니고,
걱정해주신 분들, 댓글 달아주신 분들, 영상 보러 와주신 분들, 필랑트를 디자인해주신 분들, 병원 소개해주신 분들, 약 추천해주신 분들, DM 보내주신 분들 등등…
진짜로 다 너무너무 감사합니다!

맞아요, 저는 글 재주가 없어서 다음에는 가영이가 쓰는 게 더 낫겠네요. 저는 이만 물러나도록 하겠습니다. 뿅!

감사합니다!

Pika's Cafe : 로컬 음식점인데 한국인분들도 꽤 많더라구요 ! 로코모코 꼬오오오오옥 먹어봐요 ... 크림 소스가 녹진하니 진짜 맛있어서 지금도 입에 침고여요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 접시당 1인분인데 둘이서 한 접시 먹어도 남을 양이랍니더 양이 진짜진짜 많아요 !! 투몬 소세지는 ... 낫 마이 타입 ...

야시장 이름이 뭐더라
바비큐 완전 한식당 돼지갈비 맛이라 호불호 없을 듯하옵니다. 저는 매우 극호였어요 ! 달다구리 맛있는 바비큐맛이라 가면 먹어보아요 옥수수는 무슨 맛일지 궁금하다 ... 먹어본 사람 알려죠 🌽🌽

Denny's : 완전 미국 그 자체 ! 패밀리레스토랑 온 거 같아서 기분이 좋아진답니당 저희는 가성비 메뉴로 먹었는데 접시당 만 원 정도고, 양이 그냥 생각하는 1인분이에요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 일반 플레이트 시키면 엄청 양 많을 거 같아서 가성비 메뉴 두 개 했는데 딱 굿굿 ! 다음에 가면 또 들를 예정이옵니다 데니스 죠아

판다 익스프레스 : 아메리칸 차이니즈인데 한국에서 먹는 거랑 뭔가 다르단 말이죠 ... 더 맛있어 ! 손님이 많아서 따끈따끈한 음식 바로 먹을 수 있는 게 좋았습니댜 이것 또한 양이 어마어마하게 많았다 ! 배부른 상태로 먹어서인지 또 안 가도 될 거 같어요 헤헤헤헤

리틀 씨저 : 발꼬락내 나는 꼬리꼬리 빵이 있다고 해서 먹어봤는데 냄시는 치즈 찐한 냄새 ! 소스가 토마토 피자 소스라 피자 끄트머리 먹는 느낌이었습니당 생각보다 엄청 쫄깃하진 않아서 아쉬웠지만 그래도 기름 가득 꼬숩드라구요 케이마트 가면 또 먹을 듯

맥도날드 : 아니 음료 사이즈가 남달라요 little 사이즈 시켜야 저희 small 입니다 두 개 다 또 안 먹어도 될 맛 느무 달아요

버거킹 : 치즈 덩어리 뭉쳐 놓은 거 튀긴 맛있데 마카로니 같기도 하고 간단한 간식으로 아주 좋았스무니다

이렇게 보니 먹고만 온 거 같은데 여행은 원래 먹으러 가는 거잖아요 ㅎㅎㅎㅎ 맛있는 거 먹는 게 최고 행복이라 이것저것 먹어봤는데 다른 못 가본 패스트푸드점도 많아서 아쉽습니다 ... 다음에 또 가면 더 많이 먹어보고 올게요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 아쟈아쟈

snippet.title: 나이 많은 남자친구를 만나면 안되는 이유
snippet.description:
죄송합니다, 오늘은 상세설명 칸에 상황 보고를 드리러 가영이 대신 저 편집몬이 왔습니다!

그래서 지금 눈이 어떻게 됐냐! 결론부터 말하면… 살아났습니다(?) 아니, 눈이 아주 좋아졌습니다!
그냥 좋아진 게 아니라 한 90%는 개선된 듯합니다. 인공눈물을 거의 하루에 반 통씩 쓰면서 버텼었는데, 원인이 속눈썹 때문이었다니… 이럴 거면 진작 병원 갈 걸 그랬네요. 내 눈물값…🥲

아! 참고로 탈모약 위O비도 정말 효과가 좋더군요. 고민하고 계시는 분들이 있다면 무조건 추천드리는 바입니다! (제 머리카락이 증인입니다)

그래서 뭐 이런 게 중요한 건 아니고,
걱정해주신 분들, 댓글 달아주신 분들, 영상 보러 와주신 분들, 필랑트를 디자인해주신 분들, 병원 소개해주신 분들, 약 추천해주신 분들, DM 보내주신 분들 등등…
진짜로 다 너무너무 감사합니다!

맞아요, 저는 글 재주가 없어서 다음에는 가영이가 쓰는 게 더 낫겠네요. 저는 이만 물러나도록 하겠습니다. 뿅!

감사합니다!

en-US.title: Reasons why you shouldn't date an older boyfriend
en-US.description:
I apologize, but today, I, the Editor Monster, am here instead of Gayoung to report on the situation in the details section!

So, how are my eyes doing now? To start with the conclusion… they’ve come back to life(?) No, my eyes have gotten much better!

It didn't just get better; it feels like they’ve improved by about 90%. I used to endure using almost half a bottle of artificial tears a day, but to think the cause was my eyelashes… I should have gone to the hospital sooner. The cost of my tears… 🥲

Ah! By the way, the hair loss medication WiObi is also really effective. If anyone is considering it, I highly recommend it! (My hair is proof.)

So, that’s not really important.

To everyone who worried about me, left comments, came to watch the video, designed the Philante, introduced me to a hospital, recommended medication, sent me DMs, and so on…

I really, really thank you all so much!

You're right, I'm not good at writing, so it would be better for Gayoung to write next time. I’ll be taking my leave now. Bye!

Thank you!

따뜻한 봄이 오면 여러분도 여행 다니며

en-US.title: A spirited relationship, not a sweet, lovey-dovey one
en-US.description:
Kyaaaaaa! Hello, this is Gayooii!

It's March, but why is it still so cold? ㅠㅠ So, I’ve brought you one last video of snow before winter is completely gone. Bye bye winter vibes...? Hahaha. This video is part 2 of my recent trip to Muju, and it's a winter hike. It feels a bit late, but I hope you enjoy it! I love youuuu - ♡˚

⁰ Instagram :

@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

I guess I felt super proud after hiking for the first time in a while. Watching the video, I see I’m bragging to everyone I meet, saying, “I went hiking! I went all the way to Jungbong Peak!” Hahahahahaha. Also, while crossing the mountain, the difference in weather between the shady and sunny spots was huge! It was definitely snowy and windy, but as soon as I crossed one peak, the sun was shining brightly. It was totally fascinating!

The meal tasted absolutely amazing after coming down from the mountain. But the owner's cooking was the best. The spicy pork was incredibly substantial, and the soybean paste stew was so savory that I want to eat it again ㅠㅠ I don't know if you'll see this, but it was so nice to meet the 20-year-old friends from Gimhae at the restaurant !! They were so cute !! I hope you stay healthy, do lots of fun things, and live happily ✨✨ Chatting quietly and seeing them off made it feel like I was celebrating a holiday, and it was so much fun. See you again!

The owner of the last cafe we ​​visited was so cheerful that he left a lasting impression. Teacher Suriname is the best! Didn't you get startled by the dark factory part? Hahahaha. Even I, who knew about it, was surprised when I checked the video ㅠㅠㅠ

Looking back, the trip to Muju seems to have been quite fulfilling.

When warm spring comes, you should all go on trips and

visit various regions. It's super fun. I highly recommend domestic travel too !!!!

Let's welcome the warm spring in good health! Poong -

Knit: 'Hopesmore' wool boat neck knit (ivory)

Pants: 'Lonlon' cancan ruffle layered pantskirt

Belt: 'Verbene' Fits knot leather belt

Shoes: 'UGG'

Tiny bag: 'Somewhere Butter' elly handmade knit bag

Hair scrunchie: 'Grove' sena scrunch

snippet.title: 오빠야는 내가 그래 좋나?
snippet.description:
까아아아꽁 가요이랍니다 ᠃ ♡
어제 날 완전 따숩던데 즐거운 하루 보내셨는지요
슬 봄이 오려나 봐요 뭔가 따스한 봄 냄새도 나는 것 같고 설레는 이 마음 저만 그런가용 ,,, 설렌다 설레
곧 새 학기도 시작될 텐데 설레는 마음 안고 또 므싯는 한 해를 보내보쟈구요 모두 모두 화이팅 !!!

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

이번 영상은 유럽 !!! 아니 무주 마을에 다녀왔답니다
근데 진짜 유럽 같지 않아요 ... ? 여기 예쁘다구 꽤나 유명해서 궁금했는데 실제로 가보니까 더 아기자기 잘 꾸며져 있어서 동화 속에 들어온 기분이었어요 편집몬이 이런 귀여운 곳도 알고 있다니 아주 칭찬해 - 

사실 무주까지는 제법 거리가 있어서 평소에 갈 생각을 못했었는데 스키장이 있어서 그런가 젊은이 친구도 많고 무주에서 먹은 음식이 다 맛있어서 너무 행복했어요 역시 전라도인 건가 ... 또 가고 싶어요 ... 모둠 순대 진짜 미쳤고 순댓국도 콩나물해장국처럼 깔끔한데 깊은 맛이 있었습니다 아 다음날 나오는 등산 하고 먹은 제육 정식도 진짜 맛있었는데 ... 무주 여행 2탄도 보러와요 ...♡♡ (등산 꽤나 춥고 힘들었다고 한다)

이제 곧 새학기인데 저도 학교로 돌아가요
드디어 졸업이다 !!! 모두들 더 알차고 재밌는 한 해가 되길 바라요 주말 마무리 잘 하고 이번 주도 좋은 일로 가득하길 바랍니다 뿡 -

옷 정보 드리옵니다 ᠃ ♡᠂ ♡ ˚ ♡ ᠂ 

잠옷  '스너그눅' snug pajama set
잠바 '로에일' 스웨이드 하프 후드 무스탕
니트 '썸웨어버터' hazel alpaca v-neck knit (brown)
레이어드 '가내스라' 티아 프릴 블라우스
청바지 너무 오래전에 산 거라 정보가 없으무니다 ㅠ
신발 어그 
쪼꼬미 가방 '론론' 리본 니트 백 (이것도 오래 전에 ...ㅠ)
머리 스크런치 '도넛바이닐샵' ponytail scrunchie

en-US.title: Oppa, do you like me like that?
en-US.description:
Here we go ᠃ ♡
It was so warm yesterday, did you have a nice day?
I think spring is coming. I can smell the warm scent of spring. Is it just me who feels excited? ,,, I'm so excited.
The new semester will start soon. Let's spend another exciting year with this excited heart. Fighting everyone!!!

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii 
https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

This video is from Europe!!! No, I went to Muju Village. But doesn't it really feel like Europe...? I was curious about this place because it's famously pretty, but when I actually went, it was even more charmingly decorated, making me feel like I'd entered a fairytale. I really appreciate that Editormon knows about such a cute place. -

Actually, Muju is quite a distance away, so I hadn't thought about going. Maybe it's because there's a ski resort, but I met a lot of young people, and all the food in Muju was delicious. I was so happy. Perhaps it's Jeolla-do after all... I want to go again... The assorted sundae was amazing, and the sundae soup was refreshing, like bean sprout hangover soup, but also had a deep flavor. Oh, and the pork set meal we had the next day after hiking was also really delicious... Come check out Part 2 of my Muju trip...♡♡ (I heard the hike was quite cold and tiring.)

The new semester is almost here, and I'm going back to school. Finally, graduation!!! I hope everyone has a fulfilling and fun year ahead. I hope you all have a great weekend and a week filled with good things. Pung -

두구두구두구 엄청 연락을 많이 받았던 메이크업 영상입니다 !!!!! 제가 화장을 막 잘하는 것도 아니고 사실 화장하는 거 아주 귀찮아하거든요 ,,, 그리고 늘 비슷한 화장이라 알려줄게 없어서 걱정했는데 그래도 ... 자그마하게 도움이 되길 바라요 ! 혹시 메이크업이나 뷰티같은 영상도 원한다면 ’ 쨩 ‘ 이라고 한 번씩만 남겨죠요 아주 용기가 날 것 같스무니다 ᠃ ♡

@gayooii

en-US.title: Just a video of doing makeup in the car
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Gayooii.
Here's the makeup video I've been getting so many requests for!!!!! I'm not particularly good at makeup, and honestly, I really hate it... And since I always do similar makeup looks, I was worried I wouldn't have much to share, but still... I hope it helps even a little! If you want any makeup or beauty videos, just leave a "chan" once in a while. It'll give you so much courage! ᠃ ♡

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

I used to be a total clumsy person, but when I had an external appearance, the makeup artist would come to the set and give me tons of tips and recommendations for products that suited me. Now, I feel like I've found my own makeup style! I always wanted to get my makeup done by a makeup artist, but it's always been a burden on my budget for a photoshoot. ㅠㅠㅠㅠ I learned makeup by just looking over their shoulder, but thank you for being so kind to me. I love you.

If there's anything I missed or you have any questions, please ask! I'll reply as much as I can.
Have a good weekend and a great week ahead.
I hope you're filled with happiness. 뿡 -

snippet.title: 첫 1박2일 여행을 여기로 가서 당황한
snippet.description:
이 영상은 토스증권으로부터 경제적 대가를 받고 제작되었습니다.

까아아아아꽁 ! 안녕하세요 가요이입니다 ^.^
따스한 연말 보내고 계신가요오오오 ? 곧 새해라니 시간이 정말 빠르게 흘러가는 것 같아요 ,,, 요즘 무척 춥고 건조하니까 따뜻한 음식 먹고 따뜻한 옷 입고 따뜻하게 지내셔요 아프면 안 돼애애애애

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

겨울이라 촌캉스 가면 좀 힘드려나 걱정했는데 엄청 오래된 고택인데도 구들장이 뜨끈뜨끈하고 장작 냄시도 너무 좋고 푸근하게 힐링하고 왔어요 ! 고구마 꾸워 먹으니까 진짜 행복하더라구요 ,,, 오빠가 고구마가 개똥 같다고 했지만 너무나 맛있었셔 ... 🍠 요즘 길거리에 붕어빵이며 군고구마며 맛있는 간식이 넘쳐나는데 주머니에 이천 원씩 꼭꼭 챙겨 다녀야 하는 거 알죠 ... ? ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 전 겨울되면 항상 딱 이천 원 지니고 다닌답니다 매우 소즁해 ,,,

미장을 시작한 뒤로 관심이 많아져서 자주 얘기했더니 저희가 경제 유튜브로 분류가 되었다 하더라구요 ... 덕분에 이번 영상은 토스증권의 경제적 지원을 받아서 만들었습니다 ! ✨✨ 매우 신기하고 감사합니다 꺄아아아아아아

어떤 증권사 사용할지 고민하고 있을 때 오빠가 토스증권을 강력 추천했단 말이지요 그래서 토스증권 언급을 했었는데 근데 이제는 제가 더 빠삭해져서 오빠한테 PC로 보는 법도 알려줬어요 ! 후후후 나는 가렌버핏 ...이 되고 싶달까요 ... 참 어려운 세상 ... 직접 몸으로 느끼면서 열심히 배우는 중이라 저도 잘 모르지만 같이 성장해 갑시다 !!! 우리도 할 수 있다구 !!! 아자아자

 - 뿅

en-US.title: I was shocked when I went here for my first 2-day, 1-night trip.
en-US.description:
This video was produced with financial compensation from Toss Securities.

Kaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa! Hello, this is Gayoi! ^.^
Are you having a warm end of the year? It seems like time is passing really quickly, with the new year just around the corner... It's so cold and dry these days, so eat warm food, wear warm clothes, and stay warm. Don't get sick!

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

I was worried that a country vacation would be difficult in the winter, but even though it's an old house, the stove was warm and the smell of firewood was so pleasant. It was so comforting and healing! I made sweet potatoes and ate them, and I was so happy... My husband said the sweet potatoes tasted like dog poop, but they were so delicious... 🍠 These days, the streets are overflowing with delicious snacks like bungeoppang (fish-shaped bread) and roasted sweet potatoes. You know you should always have 2,000 won in your pocket, right? ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ I always carry exactly 2,000 won with me in the winter. I'm so frugal...

Since I started doing beauty treatments, I've become more interested in it, so I've been talking about it often, and I heard we've been categorized as an economic YouTube channel... Thanks to that, I was able to make this video with financial support from Toss Securities! ✨✨ It's so amazing, thank you so much! Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

When I was wondering which brokerage to use, my brother strongly recommended Toss Securities. That's why I mentioned it, but now I'm more knowledgeable, so I even showed him how to view it on a PC! Hehe, I want to be like Karen Buffett... It's such a difficult world... I'm learning hard by experiencing it firsthand, so I don't know much myself, but let's grow together!!! We can do it too!!! Fighting!

- Bye

snippet.title: 설렘은 제로 우정과 재미만 남은 장기연애 특
snippet.description:
까아아아꽁 안녕하세요 가요이입니다
오늘도 영상 보러 와주셔서 너무 너무 감사합니다 🫰🏻
한 주 잘 보내셨나요 1월 시작한 지 얼마 되지 않은 것 같은데 벌써 1월 말을 향해 달려가고 있다니 시간이 참 빠르게 흘러가는 것 같아요 ! 저의 새해 목표는 건강하게 잘 지내기로 정해보았는데 여러분의 새해 다짐이자 목표는 무엇인가용 ... ?

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

이번 영상은 아주 소소한 일상 영상이무니다 !
원래는 날씨에 굴하지 않고 좀 더 쌩쌩했던 거 같은데 요즘은 겨울만 되면 추워서 밖을 못 돌아다니겠어요 ... 추운 날이 무서워졌어 ... 하지만 그보다 더 무서운 건 두쫑쿠의 인기였다 !! 두쫑쿠 녀석 이렇게까지 인기쟁이가 될 줄 몰랐어요 ... 두바이 쪼온득 쿠키 한두 달 전쯤엔 4500원 주고 배달시켜 먹었는데 요즘은 6500원 8000원까지도 하드라구요 맛있긴 하지만 내겐 금쫑쿠야 ... ✨

뭔가 세상은 넓고 못 가 본 맛있는 곳은 많으니까 내가 새로운 맛집을 찾겠다는 마인드로 지금까지 웨이팅하는 맛집은 잘 안 다녔는데 이렇게 줄 서서 기다림 끝에 먹어보니 원하던 걸 구했다는 성취감도 들고 더 소중하게 느껴졌던 것 같아요 재밌는 경험이었더요 ! 그나저나 두쫑쿠 함께 기다렸던 커플 친구는 두쫑쿠 맛있게 먹었으려나요 ... 서울에서 왔다기에 꼭 챙겨주고 싶었는데 아주 귀여운 커플이더라구요 ㅎㅎ🤍🤍
 
여러분이 하고 싶었던 거 이뤄보는
보람차고 마음 따뜻한 주말 보내길 바라요 !
즐거운 매일이 모여 행복이 가득하길 바랍니다 뿅 -

옷 정보 드리옵니다 ᠃ ♡᠂ ♡ ˚ ♡ ᠂ 
• 코트  '노이어포우먼' 알파카 헤링본 발마칸 코트
• 니트  '론론' flower detail v neck knit
• 치마  '시드시' white cotton skirt
• 가방  '썸웨어버터' muffin backpack
• 신발  '코모레비뮤지엄' 슬림 토우 버클 바이커 스웨이드 롱 부츠
• 귀걸이  '앵브록스' demi earring

en-US.title: A long-term relationship with zero excitement and only friendship and fun
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Gayooii.
Thank you so much for watching today's video! 🫰🏻
How was your week? It feels like January just started, but we're already rushing towards the end! Time really flies! My New Year's resolution is to stay healthy. What are your New Year's resolutions and goals?

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

This video is just a small, everyday video!
I used to be more energetic and unaffected by the weather, but these days, it's so cold in the winter that I can't go outside... I've become afraid of cold days... But what scares me even more is Doojongku's popularity!! I had no idea that Doojongku would become this popular... I used to order Dubai Choondeuk cookies for 4,500 won a month or two ago, but these days, they're even going up to 6,500 or 8,000 won. They're delicious, but they're a steal for me... ✨

The world is vast, and there are so many delicious places I haven't been to, so I've always been determined to discover new restaurants, so I've avoided waiting in line at restaurants. But after waiting in line like this, I felt a sense of accomplishment for getting what I wanted, and it felt even more precious. It was a fun experience! By the way, I wonder if the couple I waited with enjoyed their Doojongku... They were from Seoul, so I wanted to give them a treat, and they were such a cute couple. ㅎㅎ🤍🤍

I hope you all have a fulfilling and heartwarming weekend, fulfilling your dreams! I hope every day is filled with joy and happiness. Bye! -

en-US.title: My dream is to hit the jackpot with the stock market and buy my parents a new car.
en-US.description:
Oh my! Hello, this is Gayoi.
It's already the first snow... It really feels like the end of the year.
It's incredibly cold this week, and the roads are very slippery, so drive carefully! Be careful when you walk! Always take care of your health :)
I'm wearing heat tech on top and bottom to keep warm. It's hard when it's cold, shivering... ☃️☃️

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

My dad said he's been driving his current car for over 10 years and will be driving it for another 10, so I thought he wasn't interested in cars. But when he saw the 2026 Grand Koleos, he was sooooooo excited. He asked if all cars these days were like this and why it was so quiet. Hahahahaha. His surprised reaction was really funny!

Mom and Dad's reactions are so funny and cute, so spending time with my family has been the most fun lately. I guess the older you get, the more you realize the importance of family. These days, I feel like the time we spend together is truly precious. I love you, Mom and Dad! 🫰🏻

The Merci Week my brother mentioned at the end seems to be a discount event! Car discounts would be quite substantial,,, If you're curious, check out this link: https://joo.is/pifagev for more details! 🤍

It's cold outside,
but I hope you have a warm winter, both physically and mentally. Have a happy holiday season. Thank you always!
- Bye

snippet.title: 병원 가기 전 마지막 밝은 모습
snippet.description:
안녕하세요오오오 가요이입니다 :)
오늘도 날이 제법 추운데 하루 잘 보내고 계신가용  ?
상세설명 기다려주셔서 감사합니다 ! 영상 올린 당일날 많이 아프고, 그 주 동안 몸이 안 좋았어서 지금에서야 인사드려요 이제 거의 완치되었답니다 !!! 걱정해줘서 고맙고 미안해요 ㅠㅠ 한 번 크게 아프고 나니 몸이 고장난 것처럼 잘 돌아오진 않네요 여러분은 아프지 말고, 건강 꼭꼭꼭 챙기세요 ... 🍀

다행인 건지 큰 병은 아니고, 위염이랑 역류성식도염이 같이 왔는데 좀 심각하게 와서 아예 금식하고 계속 누워서 일주일 동안 고생했어요 ㅠㅠㅠ

영상 중간에 제가 약 쇼핑하러 가는 약국은 아주대학교 앞에 위치한 ‘아주 front door 약국’ 입니다 ! ( 막 의료법이런게 무섭드라구요 ,, 약국 이름 적었다가 혹시나 해서 영어 퀴즈로 바꿨습니다 ㅠㅋㅋㅋ ) 젊은 약사 언니 분이 엄청 잘 알려주셔서 저는 여기로 가요 ! 제가 비교해봤을 때는 거의 제일 저렴했는데 혹시 모르니 가서 확인해보고 구매하셔요 ✨✨

영상 보러 와주셔서 항상 감사합니다
마음 따수운 연말 되세요 !

en-US.title: Last bright look before going to the hospital
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Ooooo Gayoi :)
It's quite cold today, how are you?
Thank you for waiting for the detailed explanation! I was very sick the day I uploaded the video, and I haven't been feeling well for a week, so I'm only saying hello now. I'm almost completely recovered!!! Thank you for your concern, and I'm sorry ㅠㅠ After getting seriously ill once, it's like my body isn't recovering properly. Everyone, please don't get sick and take care of your health... 🍀

Thankfully, it wasn't a major illness. I had gastritis and reflux esophagitis together, but they were so severe that I had to fast and lie down for a week. ㅠㅠㅠ

The pharmacy I go to for medicine in the middle of the video is "Aju Front Door Pharmacy," located in front of Ajou University! (I was a bit scared of medical laws, so I wrote down the pharmacy name and then changed it to an English quiz just in case. ㅠㅋㅋㅋ) The young pharmacist gave me great advice, so I'm going here! When I compared them, it was almost the cheapest, but just in case, go check it out and buy it ✨✨

Thank you always for watching the video.
Have a warm holiday season!

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

마음 따수운 연말 되세요 !

snippet.title: 본업공개
snippet.description:
안녕하시용 가요이입니다
일교차가 제법 커졌어요 따뜻한 옷 꼭 챙겨 입고, 감기 조심하셔요 ! 라고 콧물을 훌쩍이면서 모두의 건강을 바래봅니다 ... 🍀 (제가 아플 테니 다들 아프지마요)

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

지난번에 통계청 출근 스토리 올렸는데
제가 취업한 줄 아시는 분들도 많더라고요 !
되면 좋겠지만 ... 제게는 너무 먼 정부 청사 직원의 꿈 ... 그치만 조사요원은 할 수 있지 ! 후후

정부 청사라 그런지 출근길에 보안도 엄청 철저하게 하더라구요 그래서 처음엔 약간 겁먹었으나 점심시간 때 회전초밥을 보고서 매우 친근함을 느꼈습니다 ... ㅎㅎㅎ 진짜 반가웠어욬ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오랜만에 출근이라 설렜는데 이른 아침 일어나는 건 역시나 피곤하더라구요 ... 일찍 일어난 여러분 모두 대단해요 쨩쨩 ! 출근하면서부터 퇴근하고 싶고 점심 뭐 먹을지 고민하게 되는 이 마음 ,,, 모두 똑같겠지요 ... ? 오늘 하루도 잘 보낸 모두 수고 많았어요 !

10.22 - 11.18 까지 진행하는 2025 인구주택총조사 꼭꼭 참여 부탁드린다고 합니다 ! 그리고 미리 전달 되는 우편 잘 확인하시고, 누가 찾아오면 철저히 확인하고서 문 열어줘야하는 거 알죠 ? 여러분이 제일 소중하다구 !!!

먹는 음식마다 다 맛있는 요즈음
하늘도 높고, 선선한 가을이 와부렀서요 ,,, ➰
나들이도 가고 행복한 날들로 채워가며
즐거운 매일매일 되세요 ! 🤎

 - 뿅

 + 편집몬은 아직도 주식왕 영상 댓글에 왜 ⭐️이 많은지 몰라요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 우리끼리만의 비밀 통했다 !!! 다 너무너무 귀여워요 진쨔 ... 스근하게 별 남겨준 거 보일 때마다 살짜쿵 감동했스요 ,,,, 사랑합니더

————————————————————

지금까지 우리의 100년을 그려왔고 앞으로의 100년을 그리기 위해 꼭 필요한 "2025 인구주택총조사"
올해도 여러분들께 묻고자 합니다. 대한민국에 당신의 답을 들려주세요. 

인구주택총조사에 대해 더 알고 싶다면?
☞ https://www.census.go.kr

인구주택총조사와 관련된 재미있는 콘텐츠(일러스트 등)를 보고 싶다면?
☞ https://www.census100museum.kr

[2025 인구주택총조사]
조사대상 : 대한민국을 대표하는 20% 표본가구
조사기간 : (인터넷, 전화조사) 25.10.22.~11.18.
                  (방문 면접조사) 25.11.1.~11.18.

• 구두  '사뿐' 카멜리 베이직 스틸레토힐 (이거인 거 같은데 … 사실 기억이 안나요 ㅠㅠㅠ끄앙)

제가 취업한 줄 아시는 분들도 많더라고요 !
되면 좋겠지만 ... 제게는 너무 먼 정부 청사 직원의 꿈 ... 그치만 조사요원은 할 수 있지 ! 후후

en-US.description:
Hello, this is Gayooii.
The daily temperature difference has gotten quite large. Make sure to dress warmly and be careful not to catch a cold! While sniffling, I hope everyone stays healthy... 🍀 (I'm going to get sick, so please don't get sick.)

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

Last time, I posted about my commute to work at the National Statistical Office,
and many people thought I got a job!
I wish I could, but... my dream of working at a government office is too far away... But I can be a researcher, I guess! Hehe

Perhaps because it's a government office, security was extremely tight on the way to work. I was a little scared at first, but when I saw the conveyor belt sushi during lunch, I felt a sense of familiarity... Hahaha, it was really nice. LOL

I was excited to go to work after such a long time, but waking up early in the morning was, as expected, tiring... Everyone who got up early is amazing, Jjang-chan! From the moment you get to work, you want to leave and start worrying about what to have for lunch... I'm sure we're all the same... ? Everyone had a great day today!

Please make sure to participate in the 2025 Population and Housing Census, which runs from October 22nd to November 18th! Also, check your mail carefully, and if someone comes by, you know you should thoroughly check them before opening the door, right? You're the most precious people!!!

Everything tastes delicious these days.
The sky is high, and the cool autumn weather has arrived. ➰
Go on outings and fill your days with happiness.
Have a wonderful day every day! 🤎

- Bye

+ Editmon still doesn't understand why there are so many ⭐️ comments on the Stock King video. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ Our secret is shared!!! They're all so, so cute, seriously... Every time I see you leaving behind a soft star, I'm so touched... I love you.

Pika's Cafe : 로컬 음식점인데 한국인분들도 꽤 많더라구요 ! 로코모코 꼬오오오오옥 먹어봐요 ... 크림 소스가 녹진하니 진짜 맛있어서 지금도 입에 침고여요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 접시당 1인분인데 둘이서 한 접시 먹어도 남을 양이랍니더 양이 진짜진짜 많아요 !! 투몬 소세지는 ... 낫 마이 타입 ...

야시장 이름이 뭐더라
바비큐 완전 한식당 돼지갈비 맛이라 호불호 없을 듯하옵니다. 저는 매우 극호였어요 ! 달다구리 맛있는 바비큐맛이라 가면 먹어보아요 옥수수는 무슨 맛일지 궁금하다 ... 먹어본 사람 알려죠 🌽🌽

Denny's : 완전 미국 그 자체 ! 패밀리레스토랑 온 거 같아서 기분이 좋아진답니당 저희는 가성비 메뉴로 먹었는데 접시당 만 원 정도고, 양이 그냥 생각하는 1인분이에요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 일반 플레이트 시키면 엄청 양 많을 거 같아서 가성비 메뉴 두 개 했는데 딱 굿굿 ! 다음에 가면 또 들를 예정이옵니다 데니스 죠아

판다 익스프레스 : 아메리칸 차이니즈인데 한국에서 먹는 거랑 뭔가 다르단 말이죠 ... 더 맛있어 ! 손님이 많아서 따끈따끈한 음식 바로 먹을 수 있는 게 좋았습니댜 이것 또한 양이 어마어마하게 많았다 ! 배부른 상태로 먹어서인지 또 안 가도 될 거 같어요 헤헤헤헤

리틀 씨저 : 발꼬락내 나는 꼬리꼬리 빵이 있다고 해서 먹어봤는데 냄시는 치즈 찐한 냄새 ! 소스가 토마토 피자 소스라 피자 끄트머리 먹는 느낌이었습니당 생각보다 엄청 쫄깃하진 않아서 아쉬웠지만 그래도 기름 가득 꼬숩드라구요 케이마트 가면 또 먹을 듯

맥도날드 : 아니 음료 사이즈가 남달라요 little 사이즈 시켜야 저희 small 입니다 두 개 다 또 안 먹어도 될 맛 느무 달아요

버거킹 : 치즈 덩어리 뭉쳐 놓은 거 튀긴 맛있데 마카로니 같기도 하고 간단한 간식으로 아주 좋았스무니다

이렇게 보니 먹고만 온 거 같은데 여행은 원래 먹으러 가는 거잖아요 ㅎㅎㅎㅎ 맛있는 거 먹는 게 최고 행복이라 이것저것 먹어봤는데 다른 못 가본 패스트푸드점도 많아서 아쉽습니다 ... 다음에 또 가면 더 많이 먹어보고 올게요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 아쟈아쟈

기온 차이가 크니까 감기 조심하고
매일매일 즐거운 일 하나씩 생겨나는
행복 가득한 날들 되시길 바라요

en-US.title: Honeymoon destination disaster
en-US.description:
Kka-kong Hello, this is Gayooii.
The breeze has been cool lately, so I guess fall is here. 🍂 It's nice to feel both seasons, with warm days and cool nights! The sky feels higher these days, and my mood is lifted. ☁️☁️

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/
I see a lot of people, including my friends, are going to Guam for fun! I was looking for flights, and I found some flights to Guam with good departure times and reasonable prices... I think the average round-trip flight is around 250,000 won! As expected, everyone goes there for a reason. I'm a total no-planner when it comes to travel. I'm all about just eating delicious food, so I just left really suddenly. Whew -

🌴 Guam, go eat! Guam Yoi 🌴🫧
Wendy's: I absolutely have to have the chili soup and baked potatoes. The combination is crazy. If you don't like potatoes, you have to have the chili soup. I want to eat it again. ㅠㅠ (I don't recommend the hamburger... It's so disappointing.)

Pika's Cafe: It's a local restaurant, but there were quite a few Koreans there! Try the Loco Moco! The cream sauce is so melt-in-your-mouth delicious, my mouth is watering right now. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ It's one serving per plate, but even if two people eat one plate, there's still plenty left. The portions are really, really big!! The Tumon sausage is... not my type...

What was the name of the night market?
The barbecue is totally Korean, it tastes like pork ribs, so I don't think anyone will dislike it. I absolutely loved it! It's sweet and delicious, and the barbecue flavor is delicious. I'm curious to see what the corn tastes like... Anyone who's tried it knows! 🌽🌽

Denny's: Totally American! It feels like a family restaurant, so it makes me happy. We ordered the value menu, and each plate was about 10,000 won, and the portions were just right for one person. LOLOLOLOLOL I thought the regular plate would be too much, so I ordered two value menu items, and they were perfect! I'll definitely be back next time. Denny's, thank you.

Panda Express: It's American Chinese, but it's different from what you get in Korea... It's even tastier! It was great that there were so many customers that I could eat the food hot right away. The portions were also incredibly large! I was so full after eating it that I didn't think I'd go back again. Hehehehe

Little Caesar: I tried the "tail-tail" bread because they said it smelled like toe-bites, but it smelled like rich cheese! The sauce was tomato pizza sauce, so it felt like I was eating the last bit of pizza. It wasn't as chewy as I thought, which was a shame, but it was still full of oil. I think I'll get it again when I go to Kmart.

McDonald's: No, the drink sizes are unusual. I should have ordered a small size, but it's our small. Both are so sweet that I didn't even need to eat them.

Burger King: The fried cheese chunks were delicious, but they tasted like macaroni. It was perfect as a quick snack.

Looking at this, it looks like I only ate, but traveling is all about eating, right? ㅎㅎㅎㅎ Eating delicious food is the ultimate happiness, so I tried a lot of different things, but there are still a lot of fast food places I haven't been to, so it's a shame... Next time I go, I'll try more. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ Fighting!

Be careful not to catch a cold because the temperature difference is significant.
I hope you have a happy day filled with joy, with one happy thing happening every day.

See you again in the next video - Bye

#GayoI #Guam

@gayooii

항상 행복 가득 즐거움 가득하길 바라요

en-US.title: Secretly uploaded video - Gwangju
en-US.description:
This is Gayo-iyoi.

The wind has been blowing for a while, so I thought fall was coming, but it's still quite hot... 💦 It's hard at times because of the heat, but I'll miss it again once summer passes, so enjoy it to the fullest! But it hasn't rained lately, and the weather seems to have changed a lot... It's amazing how the world feels like it's changing. I wonder what new days will unfold.

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/
I was wondering where to go, and I wanted to go eat something delicious. So, I suddenly went to Jeolla-do, the land of food! Among them, I heard that Dongmyeong-dong in Gwangju is a hot spot these days, so I went! As expected, all the young people were gathered here. The alley wasn't particularly large, but it still had quite a few unique shops.

📍Following Our Footsteps
Peach Bingsu - Cafe Sono
Udon Yum Yum - All Day Udon
Soonjji Boiled Pork - Junganggyo Food Stall
Minari Jeon and Doenjang Soolbap - Morak

I wanted to eat more, but it's a shame... I have to go again, Gwangju-u

The nights have gotten a little cooler lately,
It's one of those days where just walking around makes me happy...

I hope you're always filled with happiness and joy.
Be happy every day! 🍀

See you in the next video - Bye

en-US.description:
Hello, this is Gayoi.
This is my first time going to an amusement park! Actually, Editmon is scared of the rides,,, Hehehee, so I've been there with my friends before, but this is the first time we've gone together! But even the amusement park without the rides is pretty fun... 😆🤍

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

I just realized that the amusement park is so big and the zoo is so well-organized...! I always remember running to the rides and waiting in line, but when I walked around like I was at a park, there were a lot of other things to enjoy! Next time you go, make sure to say hello to the orang and the yellow monkey,, 🦧 It was amazing to communicate and they were cute because they responded, but on the other hand, my heart was touched...!

As expected, all the cast members at the amusement park are so cute,,
I had fun going there and felt like I gained more energy thanks to them! I was so happy to see all the lovers, family, and friends I met that day! They all looked so happy that I wanted to record that moment... So I asked myself, "Should I take a picture for you?" before I knew itㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ I felt like I was giving memories to everyone I met, so I was so happy 🫧 But do you know that Instax photos that actually print have a different feeling from photos taken with a cell phone... en-US.title: Running at 233 km/h... "Is the brake on the left??"
en-US.description:
Mohen - Hello, this is Gayoi.
Did you see the video I uploaded last week about my first overseas business trip? The headquarters of the company that invited us! We headed to Hanover, the home of Continental Tires, with a heart full of excitement 🛣️🚙🚗

Everyone else said they flew between cities, but when will I ever get to drive on the European Autobahn again? I was half excited and half worried, so I decided to rent a car and drive for 4 hours myself! But it was easier to drive than I thought. It didn't feel like I was driving for a long time because it was smooth and smooth! If you think about it, I might be a driving master...? Hehe

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

After buying my first car, a Lumpa, I had many opportunities to drive, so I started to feel the fun of driving a little! So I wanted to go to the circuit, but thanks to Continental Tires, I was able to drive on the track without any worries and feel the high-performance car and high-performance tires. Isn't driving so much fun? But... I realized this time that tires are really important! To be honest, at first I thought tires were made of rubber so what's the difference? But even if the car is the same, the tires are different so the driving feel is different, such as the degree of slipping, the degree of contact when turning, etc.! I experimented with the car myself and solved my curiosity

Still, everyone always drive safely,
Don't get tired of the hot summer heat,
I hope you have a happy, joyful, and leisurely July 🍀

See you in the next video - Byong

en-US.title: Business couple(?) enjoying 14 hours of economy class
en-US.description:
Ka ah ah kong hello this is gayoi
Dugudugu I went on my first overseas business trip! I was going for work, but I was so excited about going far away by plane,,, It was so amazing that they called us from a faraway country! In the last video, everyone said that it would be hard to fly economy class on a 14-hour long-distance flight, but I got a very cheap fare of 266,000 won... Of course I'll fly! Hehe, the in-flight meal was more delicious than I thought, and I had a really fulfilling time and had fun flying and coming back. Swoosh -

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/
  
It was my first time renting a car overseas and driving for the first time, so I was really nervous, but it was very similar to what I thought! It was just like driving in Korea, but it was really cool that there was an unlimited speed zone. Those cars were flying by like rockets... So I had no choice(?) but to drive too ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ In the next video, I'll show you my circuit skills and incredible speed driving. I might be the best driver! 사실 몇 년 전에 군대로드를 찍으며 슬쩍 들린 적 있는 동네였는데 많은 분과 얘기 나누고 갈 만한 곳 추천받아서 이틀동안 맛있는 거 먹고 힐링한 것 같아요 ! 생각보다 가까운 거리였고, 번잡하지 않아서 너무너무 평화로운 느낌이 드는 곳이었습니다 🌳

나라 지켜주심에 너무 감사하고, 또 몸도 마음도 건강하게 전역하길 바라요 🫶🏻🫶🏻 국군 장병 친구들 오늘도 힘내요 빠이팅 !

snippet.title: 커플 유튜브는 수익을 '몇 대 몇'으로 나눌까
snippet.description:
까 - 꽁 안녕하세요 가요이입니다
시간이 너무 빠르게 지나가는 것 같습니다 슝 - 나이가 들수록 시간이 빨리 흘러간다던데 요즘 느끼고 있는 건가 ... 다들 행복 가득 건강하게 살자구요 🍀

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/
  
요번 영상은 오빠가 이상한 걸 만들었더라고요 ?
너무 늦게 돌아온 거 같아 죄송하고, 또 기다려주어 마음 가득 고마워요 ,,, 🫶🏻🫶🏻 근데 그렇게까지 짠순이는 아닌 거 같은데 ... 짠순이 맞는 거 같기도 하고... 엄마랑 친구들이랑 오빠가 감탄하기는 해요 ...

솔직히 다들 마트 가서 카트에 물건 담기 전에 가격 비교하고 제품 검색해 보고, 옷 쇼핑할 때도 당연히 최저가 알아보고, 기름 넣기 전에 휘발유 최저가 검색해서 찾아가지 않나요 ... ? 동일한 무언가를 하는데 더 저렴하게 할 수 있으면 좋잖아요 ! 나만 그런겅가

아 그리고 패스트푸드점은 가기 전에 어플 깔아두면 할인 쿠폰 아주 빵빵하답니다 ... 어차피 다 새로운데 저는 할인쿠폰 주는 거만 먹어요 ! 백화점은 마감떨이 하는 7시 즈음 맞춰서 가면 훨씬 저렴하게 먹거리 살 수 있다구 ! 카드사 혜택, 통신사 할인 같은 거도 꼭 확인해서 다 혜택 받기 🌟

2025년도 벌써 절반이나 되었다니
스스로 잘 지내온 상반기를 칭찬하며,
앞으로 무얼 하면 좋을지 잘 꾸려나가는
한 해를 만들어 보쟈구요 !
그럼 이만 뾰 - 옹

#가요이

솔직히 다들 마트 가서 카트에 물건 담기 전에 가격 비교하고 제품 검색해 보고, 옷 쇼핑할 때도 당연히 최저가 알아보고, 기름 넣기 전에 휘발유 최저가 검색해서 찾아가지 않나요 ... ? 동일한 무언가를 하는데 더 저렴하게 할 수 있으면 좋잖아요 ! 나만 그런겅가

아 그리고 패스트푸드점은 가기 전에 어플 깔아두면 할인 쿠폰 아주 빵빵하답니다 ... 어차피 다 새로운데 저는 할인쿠폰 주는 거만 먹어요 ! 백화점은 마감떨이 하는 7시 즈음 맞춰서 가면 훨씬 저렴하게 먹거리 살 수 있다구 ! 카드사 혜택, 통신사 할인 같은 거도 꼭 확인해서 다 혜택 받기 🌟

2025년도 벌써 절반이나 되었다니
스스로 잘 지내온 상반기를 칭찬하며,
앞으로 무얼 하면 좋을지 잘 꾸려나가는
한 해를 만들어 보쟈구요 !
그럼 이만 뾰 - 옹

en-US.title: How much will couples on YouTube split their revenue?
en-US.description:
Kka - Gong Hello, this is Gayoi.
Time seems to pass by so quickly. Shhh - They say time passes faster as you get older, is that what you're feeling these days? Let's all live happily and healthily. 🍀

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/
  
Didn't my brother make something weird in this video?
I'm sorry I'm so late, and I'm so grateful for waiting for you. 🫶🏻🫶🏻 But I don't think I'm that stingy... I guess I am... My mom, friends, and brother are impressed...

Honestly, before going to the grocery store, don't we all compare prices and research products? When shopping for clothes, we naturally check for the lowest price, and before filling up the tank, we search for the lowest price on gasoline? Wouldn't it be nice to do the same thing for less? Is it just me?

Oh, and if you download the app before going to a fast food restaurant, you'll find tons of discount coupons... They're all new anyway, so I only eat the ones with discount coupons! If you go to department stores around 7 p.m. when they close, you can get groceries much cheaper! Be sure to check out credit card and mobile carrier discounts to take advantage of them all! 🌟

It's already halfway through 2025.
Let's praise ourselves for the first half of the year,
and make this a year where we plan ahead and do our best!
Well, that's it for now, Pyo-ong.

#Gayoi

ko.description:
까아아아꽁 안녕하세요 가요이입니다
요즘 날씨가 너무 좋아서 기분이 절로 좋아지는 것 같아요 ,,, 정말 창문 열어두기만 해도 설렘 가득하지 않나용 집에만 앉아있기는 아쉬워서 어디라도 훌쩍 떠나고 싶은 요즘 입니댜 🏃🏻🏃🏻‍♀️

@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

아니 !!!! 판교역에서 출발하는 KTX 있는 거 알고 계셨나요 ... ? 이렇게 좋은 걸 난 왜 이제야 알았냐며 지하철역으로 기차가 들어오는데 너무 신기하더라구요 도라에몽 어디로든 문 같은 느낌이었습니다 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 시기도 딱 벚꽃 만개날 맞춰서 도착해서인지 너어어어어무 예뻤답니다 ! 설렘 즐거움 행복 가득 문경 ... 인생 여행지 되어버렸어요 ... 🩵

en-US.title: A girlfriend who is 'overly' clingy
en-US.description:
Kaaa ... Mungyeong, full of excitement, joy, and happiness... It's become a lifelong travel destination... 🩵

It was so good that I was worried it would be difficult to reserve tickets for the KTX connecting train to Mungyeong because there were so many people. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ Don't become famous. I'm going alone. No, let's go together. ,,, ~

I've heard a lot about Mungyeong Yakdol Pig, but now that I know why it's called Yakdol Pig, my curiosity has been satisfied! And the cafes I stopped by unexpectedly were all delicious. The suspension bridge was a bit scary, but it was also beautiful. The cherry blossom road along Mojeoncheon Stream was really pretty. The elderly people were so welcoming and kind, making it a trip that doubled my happiness! Maybe it's because I was born in Gaengsangdo...? The small talk was so much fun! I even got some rice cakes from the Mungyeong grandmother and came back with lots of good memories.

A very fulfilling trip to Mungyeong.

snippet.title: 설레기엔 너무 오래만난, 안하기엔 너무 재밌는, 그런 연애
snippet.description:
까아아아꽁 가요이입니다
너무 오랜만에 돌아온 거 같은 이 느낌 ,,, 잘 지내고 계신가용 ? 많이 보고 싶었다구 ! 저는 왔다리갔다리 날씨 덕분에 감기 걸렸지만 여러분덜은 아푸지 마세요 내가 대신 아플 테니 ... 는 모두 아프지 맙시다

날씨가 덥다가 비 왔다가 섭섭할까 봐 눈도 오고 바람이 엄청 불었다가 오늘내일은 또 엄청 덥대요 매우 어메이징 날씨 ☀️☔️❄️🌪️

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

다 못 담은 게 아쉬울 정도로 수원에 놀러 갈 곳이 진짜 많은 것 같아요 ! 시장은 걷다 보니 나오던데 규모가 엄청 크고 맛있는 거도 많이 팔고 사람도 많고 너무 재밌더라구요 시장 참 좋댜 ,,, 체질인가봅니다

행궁동은 정!말! 제 방앗간입니다 한 달에 세네 번은 가는 거 같아요 저번주도 두 번이나 다녀왔다는 ,, 갈 때마다 새로운 볼거리가 생겨있고, 성곽 걷기도 좋고 방화수류정도 예쁘고 마음까지 가득 채워지는 여유로운 동네인 거 같아요 그리고 마지막으로 제 친구 가게 ‘디아노체' 진짜 맛있어요 ... 원래도 음식 좋아하지만 여기 파스타는 먹고나면 종종 생각나요ㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓㅓ 셔 ㅕㅕㅕㅕㅓㅓㅓ
(여기까지 쓰고 잠결에 키보드를 눌렀다고 합니다. 그래도 그냥 그대로 복붙했습니다_편집몬)

요즘 날도 맑은데
여기저기 돌아다니며
마음껏 사랑하세요
사랑합니다 🤍

이번 영상은 미장에 입문한 가요이입니다 !
아부지 차량 마련을 위해서 돈을 모으는 중인데 사드리고 싶은 자동차는 너무 비싸더라고요 ㅠㅠ

이번 주 날씨는 아주 다채로웠던 거 같아요
화요일인가 갑자기 눈이 왕창 오더니 주말 되니까 무척 따스하군요 눈이 와서 좋았고, 따뜻해서 좋다 이 말입니다 아무쪼록 감기 조심하시고 행복 가득하길 바라요 !
감기 조심하세요이 🍀

en-US.description:
Kka-kong! Hello! This is Gayoi.
I haven't started my videos with "Kkakong" lately... I just realized something. I should start the next video with "Kkakong" ~~~ 🤍

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

This video is about Gayoi getting started in the world of plastering!
I'm saving up for my dad's car, but the cars I want to buy him are so expensive. ㅠㅠ

So, I was wondering if there was a way to save money faster, and I followed Editmon into plastering. Ta-da, this path I chose is definitely going to pay off... ?

I actually wanted to try it, but I didn't know what it was, and there were so many difficult terms, so I didn't. Lately, Editmon has started plastering and has been living a sleepy life... So, even though I'm a complete beginner who doesn't even know what NASDAQ is, I'm going to try and learn a little! After all, getting started is half the battle!

This week's weather has been incredibly varied.
It suddenly snowed heavily on Tuesday, but it's been incredibly warm this weekend. It was nice to have the snow, and it's nice to be warm. Please take care not to catch a cold and I hope you're filled with happiness!
Be careful not to catch a cold! 🍀

snippet.title: 가장 불편하고 어색한 시승기
snippet.description:
까아아아꽁 ! 가요이입니다
벌써 3월이라니 ,,, 시간이 무지 빠르게 흘러가네요 ! 요즘 날씨가 좀 풀린 듯 아직은 조금 추우니까 겹겹이 따뜻하게 입고 다녀요 ! 특히 요번주 화요일 춥대요
감기 조심하세요이 🍀🫧🫧

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

아부지 차 시동이 꺼져서 견인차에 실려 온 적이 있는데 그 이후로 걱정도 많이 되더라구요 ... 그래서 차 척척박사인 편집몬한테 의뢰했답니다 ! 오빠에게 아주 어려운 ‘차’ 라고 생각했는데 별로 어려워하는 거 같진 않네요 ... ? ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 오히려 좋아 ! 

새 차로 바꿨으면 하는 마음에서 조금씩 열심히 돈을 모아봤는데 자동차가 저렇게나 비싼 줄 몰랐습니다. 룸파를 만난 건 행운이였다 ... 자동차 가격 보고는 더 열심히 살아야겠다는 다짐을 하고 왔어요 !

열심히 돈 더 모아서
아부지 차 마련할 그 날까지 ,,,
차가 멈추지 않아야 할텐데 말이지요 ㅠ
열심히 달려가 봅시다 ! 우리 모두 므쨍이네 - 🤍

** 가요이의 옷장정보
- 코오트  '노이어포우먼' 알파카 헤링본 발마칸 코트 (브라운)
- 니트  '쎄미' color round knit (BL)
- 신발  'UGG' classic short 2 (chestnut)
- 바지  '론론' back heart stitch pocket denim pants white
- 귀걸이  'hei' donut ring earring (white)

en-US.title: The most uncomfortable and awkward test drive
en-US.description:
Wow! It's Gayooii!
It's already March... Time flies! The weather seems to have warmed up a bit lately, but it's still a bit chilly, so dress warmly! It's supposed to be especially cold this Tuesday.
Watch out for colds! 🍀🫧🫧

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

My dad's car died and had to be towed away, and I've been really worried ever since... So I asked Editmon, the car expert! I thought "cars" would be a really difficult thing for my brother, but he doesn't seem to be having too much trouble... ? Hahahaha. I'm actually happy about it!

I've been saving up money little by little with the hopes of buying a new car, but I had no idea cars were so expensive. Meeting Lumpa was such a stroke of luck... Seeing the car prices has made me want to work harder!

I'll work hard to save more money

until the day Dad can buy a car...

I hope the car never stops, right? ㅠ
Let's keep going! We're all so cute! - 🤍

snippet.description:
까 - 꽁 안녕하세요 가요이입니다
잘 지내고 계신가용 ? 2월 말이면 좀 따뜻해질 줄 알았으나 여전히 너무 추운 요즈음입니다 ! 좋은 소식은 다음주 되면 제법 따수워진대요 꺄아아아 💌💌

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

이번 영상은 저희의 지난 발자취를 담아보았습니다 ... 🫧 내가 뭘 하면 좋을까 지금 하고 있는 일이 잘 맞는 건가에 대한 고민은 누구나 갖고 있잖아요 ,,, 저도 원래 꿈은 선생님이었는데 지금의 일을 만나게 되었어요 ! 그 사이에 있었던 저희의 돌풍 같은 고민의 시기와 그때의 솔직한 이야기를 담아보았습니다 ! 그리고 또다시 들게 된 고민 ... 무엇을 하면 좋을까용 ... ?

마음속에 올해 목표 하나씩 갖고 있을 텐데 시작이 반이라고 그랬어요 ! 실행력이 무지 중요한 거 같습니다 ! 여러분들의 목표이자, 해볼까 고민 중인 일들이 있다면 공유해주세요 ,,, 같이 도전해 보아요 ! 함께 으쌰으쌰하고 더 잘 해낼 수 있을 거라구 !

매년 지나오면서
올해 말에는 내가 어떤 모습일까 꿈꿔보는데
열심히 달려가 봅시다 ! 우리 모두 므쨍이네 - 🤍

** 가요이의 옷장정보
어쩌다보니 론론룩
- 코오트  '론론' wool hoodie short duffle coat
- 니트  너무 오래전에 사서 정보가 없서용 ...
- 레이어드티샤쓰  '론론' frill shirring long sleeve T
- 바지  '론론' side lace track denim
- 비둘기가방  'uios'

#가요이 #귀엽당

snippet.title: 방송에선 다 편집된, 하지만 귀여운 가요이 모음.mp4
snippet.description:
안녕하세요 까치까치까 - 꽁 가요이입니다
새해 잘 보내고 계신가요 ? 몸도 마음도 건강한 한 해가 되길 바라요 ! 미세먼지가 통 많더니 요즘은 푸른 하늘을 되찾았어요, 날도 막 매섭게 춥진 않은 것 같아 밖에 나가고 싶은데 막상 나가면 추운 거 알죠 ... ? 옷 따뜻하게 입으시고 감기 조심하세용 🌟

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

이번 영상은 mbc 에브리원에 방영되었던 ’촌스러운 한달살기 시즌2’ 로 지냈던 강화살이 모음집입니다 ! 분명 촬영이 작년 9월이었는데 ... 벌써 3개월도 더 지났네요 정말 시간이 슈슈슉 금방 가는 거 같아요 ! 그만큼 삶의 행복한 페이지도 가득 쌓여가고 있는 거겠죠 ?

프로그램 이름은 한 달 살기였지만, 직접 숙소를 돈 주고 빌렸던 터라 한 달 동안 매주 촬영하는 날에 강화로 갔었어요 ! 그래서인지 제 3의 고향 같고, 누가 강화 놀러 간다고 하면 소개해 주고 싶어서 간질간질하네요 ,, 마을 이장님이자 숙소 사장님, 옆집 할머님, 강아지 로또 모두 그립따아아아 저희가 지냈던 강화에서의 날들이 시간이 지나며 점차 애틋해질 것 같아요 !

마음속에 올해 목표 하나씩 갖고 있을 텐데 시작하고 해보면 안되는 게 ... 있겠죠 ? 그래도 새로운 길로 안내해 줄지 또 모르는 거고, 해보면서 얻는 무언가가 있을 거니까 우리 같이 힘내서 걸어가 보아요 ! 
우리 모두 므쨍이네 - 🤍

** 가요이의 옷장정보
0:01 앉아서 테레비를 보아요룩
- 니트  '트와 TRWA' 웨일스 모헤어 플라워 가디건
- 티샤쓰  '모데스트무드' base long sleeve
- 귀걸이  'hei' donut ring earing

en-US.title: A collection of cute songs that were edited out on air.mp4
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Kkachi Kkachi - Gong Gayoi. How are you doing in the new year? I hope you have a healthy year, both physically and mentally! The fine dust was so bad, but the skies have cleared up recently. It doesn't feel that cold anymore, so I want to go outside, but you know how cold it is when you go out...? Dress warmly and be careful not to catch a cold. 🌟

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

This video is a compilation of our time in Ganghwa, which aired on MBC Every1 for "Countryside Living for a Month Season 2"! Filming was definitely in September of last year... but already more than three months have passed. Time really flies! It must mean that the happy pages of our lives are filling up, right?

The program was called "One Month Living," but since we rented our own accommodations, we went to Ganghwa every week for filming for a month! Maybe that's why it feels like a third home, and whenever someone says they're going to Ganghwa, I'm itching to introduce them. I miss the village chief, the inn owner, the old lady next door, and Lotto the puppy. I think the days we spent in Ganghwa will become more and more fond as time goes by!

You probably have a goal in mind for this year, but if you start and try, there will be some things you can't do... right? But you never know, it might lead you down a new path, and you'll gain something from it, so let's keep going!

We're all so happy - 🤍

** Gayoi's Wardrobe Info
0:01 Sit-down TV Look
- Knit 'Twa TRWA' Welsh Mohair Flower Cardigan
- T-shirt 'Modest Mood' base long sleeve
- Earrings 'hei' donut ring earring

#Gayoi

snippet.title: 군대 보낸거 아닙니다
snippet.description:
Happy new year ! ✨✨
까아아아꽁 2025 뉴 가요이입니다
늘 똑같이 뜨고 지는 하루이지만 새해라는 이유로 괜히 마음가짐이 달라지는 것 같아요 ,,, 아쉬움은 훌훌 털어버리고 긍정적인 마음으로 가득 채워보아요 ! 🍀

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

오랜만에 아침 수업도 듣고 새로운 친구들 만나서 학교 다니니까 정말 새내기 된 기분이었습니다 굉장히 설레는 느낌이었다구 ! 처음엔 학교가 다 거기서 거기지 싶었는데 해양대는 무척 다르더라구요 ,, 수업은 물론이고 학교생활 자체가 아예 달랐던 거 같아요 !

친구들이 거의 다 꿈이 뚜렷해서 학과의 특성상 졸업과 동시에 취업한다는 게 너무 신기했고, 고등학교 때 이렇게 다양한 학교와 학과가 있는 걸 몰랐을까 하는 생각도 들었답니다 ! 그치만 점호 ... 저는 매일은 못 할 것 같아요 ... 해양대 칭구들 대단해 ...

새내기 등교룩

- 바지  오디서 산 건지 기억이 안나용 ... 정보 못 찾겠다꾀꼬리

- 신발  '마크모크' 메리제인 벨크로 스니커즈

snippet.title: [일상] 70만 유튜버의 학교생활
snippet.description:
까아아아꽁 ! 가요이입니다
시간이 너무너무 빠르게 지나가는 것 같아요 슝 -
나이가 들수록 시간이 빨리 간다던데 요즘 체감 중이에요 ... 요즘 독감 유행이라는데 유행에 질 수 없어서 저도 현재 감기로 꽤나 고생중입니댜 ☃️ (추우니까 집콕 최고 감기 조심하세효 )

⁰ Instagram :
@gayooii 
 https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

요번 영상은 저의 근황 보고 겸
대학 생활에 대한 소소한 생각들을 담은 영상입니다 !
어떻게 보면 저는 지금 학업과 일을 병행하는 중인데 제 주변 친구들이나 동생인 친구들과 얘기를 해보면 진로에 대한 고민이 정말 많더라고요 ,,,

물론 제가 결정해 줄 수는 없는 일이겠지만 어떻게 대학 생활을 보냈고, 또 무슨 생각을 하며 지냈는지 담아보았습니다 ! 대학생이었기에 남는 시간에 이것저것 시도해 봤던 거 같은데 인턴, 공모전, 대외 연합동아리, 홍보대사, 아르바이트, 학교 동아리, 서포터즈 등 꽤나 바지런히 보냈네요 ... ?

내가 뭘 좋아하고 잘할 수 있을까 고민하고 일단 해보면서 찾아다녔거든요 ! 나의 길을 찾아가며 마음껏 길을 잃어도 보고 또 새로운 길을 만들어가며 잘 놀면 되지 않을까 싶어요 !

2024년도도 정말 얼마 남지 않았네요
즐거움도 아쉬움도 가득했을 한 해를 잘 채워 온
스스로를 칭찬하며, 이번 연도는 이만 잘 보내주고
새로움으로 가득할 한 해를 맞이해 봅시댜 ! 
좋아해 주셔서 너무 감사했습니다 🤍
그럼 이만 뾰 - 옹

** 가요이의 옷장정보 (슈비루비루바빱바)
학교 등교룩
- 파란잠바  '론론' DUMBLE SHORT DUFFLE MUSTANG JACKET (DUSTY BLUE)
- 니트  'comgen' 변형 케이블 크랍 풀오버 (스카이블루)
- 바지  오디서 산 건지 기억이 안나용 ... 정보 못 찾겠다꾀꼬리
- 가방  'nieeh' NYLON BACKPACK (BLACK)
- 신발  'UGG' classic short 2 (chestnut)

학교 출근룩 (죽전)
- 코오트  '론론' WOOL HOODIE SHORT DUFFLE COAT
- 니트  'RE_L' Cheek boucle knit (pink)
- 바지  '리얼코코' 와이드데일리코튼팬츠 (블랙)
- 신발  '마크모크' 메리제인 벨크로 스니커즈

학교 출근룩 (천안)
- 코오트  '노이어포우먼' 알파카 헤링본 발마칸 코트 (브라운)
- 니트  '소치이' 오프라인에서 산 거라 정보가 없어요 ... ㅠ
- 바지  '리얼코코' 와이드데일리코튼팬츠 (블랙)
- 신발  '마크모크' 메리제인 벨크로 스니커즈

en-US.title: Let's visit the village of the horny demons in Namhae, full of yang energy.
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Gayooii.
This will probably be my last travel video of the year.
Time really flies. A year has already flown by. But let's make the most of the rest of this year!
(Production Support: Namhae County)

⁰ Instagram:
@gayooii

https://www.instagram.com/gayooii/

I went last month, and the weather was so warm, almost perfect, as if the weather fairy was with me... It was so great! I've traveled domestically many times, but Namhae has such a beautiful, peaceful ocean and so many places to visit!

I had a great time and had a great time.
I'm thinking about going back to Namhae again in the summer. It's so nice... I think I found a good place to stay. When I opened my eyes, I was floating in the middle of the ocean, feeling like I was on vacation. I was so happy!
